name: bar-chart
title: Bar Chart
description: A column chart for bucketed counts: every column labelled, one optionally featured, a tooltip on hover. Uses namespace exports: BarChart.Root.

docs.lead: One rounded column per bucket, scaled to the tallest, with every bucket labelled underneath. Built from flex rather than a charting library so no label is ever dropped.
docs.usage:
import * as BarChart from "@/components/ui/bar-chart"

<BarChart.Root
  items={[{ label: "0 - 9", value: 111 }]}
  highlighted="0 - 9"
  dimension="Group"
  unit="Items"
/>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: One featured column. Hover a column for its count; dimension and unit name what the tooltip shows.

examples.title: Without highlight
examples.description: Leave highlighted out when no bucket should stand out. The chart never picks the tallest for you.

api.name: BarChart.Root
api.description: The columns and their label row. Fills its container's height.

props.name: items
props.description: Columns left to right, in the order given

props.name: highlighted
props.description: Label of the column to feature. Omitted or null features none

props.name: dimension
props.description: What the buckets are, after the bucket in the tooltip caption ("10 - 19 Group"). For ranges; leave it off where the bucket names itself

props.name: unit
props.description: What the value counts, beside it in the tooltip
